The previous cutoff estimate discarded the probability of the low-density event. Conditional Jensen and the mean constraint determine its exact scalar contribution: the maximal total moment under a strict tail cap is U(tau)=tau+K^s(1-p_tau), where p_tau is the lower root of h(p)=tau.

The analytical note proves feasibility, equality-law uniqueness and the dyadic Boolean-cube qualification. Applying the existing two-sign bound gives a strictly larger sufficient transfer-gap region. At s=2, K=3/4 the sufficient budget increases from5/4 to25/17; the separate constructive collapse budget remains7/4. This does not identify an optimal spectral threshold or establish external priority.
